Initial release of call-claude-sonnet-4-agent skill.

- Provides an AI agent for specialized "call claude sonnet 4 agent" tasks.
- Enforces strict language-matching with user input or explicit language requests.
- Designed for collaborative brainstorming as a creative team member, responding only to tasks/issues posed by the CCO.
- Operates exclusively using context in provided meeting minutes; does not infer or recall external information.
- Includes clear instructions for professional, focused, and creative participation in meetings.
